mangaTools.settings.enabledLanguages.des: Only these languages appear in the edit-page dropdown. Display (badge and detail row) is unaffected. Leave empty to show every language.
mangaTools.settings.showFlags.heading: Show flags
mangaTools.settings.showFlags.descriptio: Draw the flag beside the language name. Turn this off to show the name on its own.
mangaTools.settings.showCoverBadge.headi: Show the language on gallery covers
mangaTools.settings.showCoverBadge.descr: The badge in the bottom-right of a gallery's cover. With flags turned off it shows the language name instead of a flag.
mangaTools.settings.openDetailsBlock.des: The Manga info section in a gallery's details tab. Collapsed, its heading is what says the section is there. This decides the state a block opens in, not whether it can be opened.
mangaTools.settings.openEditBlock.descri: The Manga info block in a gallery's edit form, where its language, censorship and translation group are set. This decides the state a block opens in, not whether it can be opened.
mangaTools.settings.hidePerformers.headi: Hide the performers field on a manga gallery
mangaTools.settings.hidePerformers.descr: A manga gallery rarely has performers, so its edit page leaves the field out. Only the field is hidden — whatever a gallery already has stays on the gallery and is kept when it is saved. The bulk edit dialog and the details tab are unaffected.
mangaTools.settings.chapters.heading: Import chapters from Stash
mangaTools.settings.chapters.description: Copies every marked gallery's Stash chapters into this plugin's own chapters field — the one the reader prefers, and the one nothing has ever written. Nothing of Stash's is changed. Galleries that already have a list of this plugin's own are left alone unless you ask to replace them.
